title: Lung-brain axis in asthma: linking type 2 inflammation, environmental triggers, and neuroinflammation
title_zh: 哮喘中的肺脑轴：连接第2型炎症、环境触发因素与神经炎症
abstract: Abstract Asthma is a heterogeneous airway disease that may have systemic and neuroimmune effects in selected phenotypes and disease states. Central to this lung-brain link is airway epithelial barrier dysfunction. Injury induced by allergens and pollutants prolongs inflammatory signaling and promotes the release of type 2-associated alarmins, notably IL-33, TSLP, and IL-25, which initiate and sustain type 2 immune programs. These upstream epithelial cues drive hallmark pulmonary features, including eosinophilic inflammation and airway remodeling; however, their direct contribution to neurovascular or CNS immune changes in human asthma has not been established. Across clinical studies and neuroimaging datasets, asthma is associated with increased risk of anxiety, depression, sleep disruption, and cognitive impairment, alongside evidence of altered activity in brain networks involved in interoception, emotion regulation, and cognition. Experimental studies provide biological plausibility for brain-relevant immune responses following allergic airway inflammation, but do not establish an epithelial-alarmin-to-CNS causal pathway in human asthma. We integrate exposure-dependent epithelial responses with asthma endotypes and parallel humoral, neurovascular, and neural routes; distinguish associative human findings from experimental mechanisms; and identify testable interventions and evidence gaps without assuming proven CNS benefit.
abstract_zh: 摘要 哮喘是一种异质性气道疾病，在某些表型和疾病状态下可能具有全身和神经免疫效应。肺脑联系的核心是气道上皮屏障功能障碍。过敏原和污染物诱导的损伤延长炎症信号并促进第2型相关警报物质的释放，尤其是IL-33、TSLP和IL-25，这些物质启动并维持第2型免疫程序。这些上游上皮信号驱动肺部特征性表现，包括嗜酸性粒细胞炎症和气道重塑；然而，它们对人类哮喘中神经血管或中枢神经系统免疫变化的直接贡献尚未确定。在临床研究和神经影像数据集中，哮喘与焦虑、抑郁、睡眠障碍和认知受损的风险增加相关，并伴有涉及内感、情绪调节和认知的脑网络活动改变的证据。实验研究为过敏性气道炎症后脑相关免疫反应提供了生物学可行性，但未能确立人类哮喘中上皮-警报物质到中枢神经系统的因果通路。我们整合了暴露依赖的上皮反应与哮喘亚型，并并行考虑体液、神经血管和神经通路；区分人类关联发现与实验机制；并在不假设已证实的中枢神经系统益处的前提下，识别可检验的干预措施和证据空白。
